subject.title: feat: add publisher follow controls and discovery

question: Should ClawHub accept publisher-follow controls and discovery as core product/API surface now, and should this follow-up wait for the base API PR to land first?
rationale: This is a new user-facing feature with a private follow-state API, so automation cannot decide the product/API boundary or accept the stacked branch before maintainer intent is clear.

options.title: Land the base API first
options.body: Require https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2950 to clear proof, docs, and merge conflicts, then rebase and review this UI/discovery slice on top.

options.title: Review the stack together
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally review the API, controls, and notification PRs as one feature stack while owning the private follow-state boundary together.

options.title: Pause the follow-up
options.body: If the base follow API direction is not accepted, pause or close this follow-up rather than carrying a conflicting stacked branch.

recommendation.title: Land the base API first
recommendation.body: Require https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2950 to clear proof, docs, and merge conflicts, then rebase and review this UI/discovery slice on top.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen has the strongest current-main history across the route/schema package and creators/profile surfaces this feature extends.
